# Apple Music Playlist Toolkit v1.2.0

This is the first normal, non-prerelease release of the installable toolkit.

## Highlights

- Nine complete regional README entry points: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese,
  Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, German, and French.
- Clear setup for Codex, Claude, Cursor, VS Code/Copilot, Gemini CLI, Windsurf, Docker,
  Cordis/DSH, generic agent harnesses, and Harness Platform.
- A non-root Docker image, Compose configuration, and a container MCP handshake test in CI.
- Stronger MCP interoperability: version negotiation, bilingual server/tool guidance, risk
  annotations, required-argument validation, and standard JSON-RPC parse/shape errors.
- Package installation and console-script smoke checks now run in CI on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

## Upgrade

```bash
pip install --upgrade "apple-music-playlists @ git+https://github.com/Z-Han-Z/apple-music-playlists.git@v1.2.0"
```

Existing credentials and caches remain in the same locations. No re-login or data migration is
required. See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Z-Han-Z/apple-music-playlists/blob/v1.2.0/CHANGELOG.md)
for the full list of changes.
